name: Equatorial Para Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
summary: Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. distributes electricity to residential, industrial, commercial, corporate, and rural customers in the state of Pará. It distributes electricity in five regions, including Belém, Castanhal, Marabá, Santarém, and Altamira; and serves 144 municipalities comprising approximately 8.6 million customers. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Belém, Brazil. Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia S.A.
